author: Y Combinator
description:
YC Visiting Partner Vivian Shen sits down with Paul Graham at the original YC office in Mountain View to talk about startups, AI, ambition, and what makes great founders.

Apply to Y Combinator: https://www.ycombinator.com/apply
Work at a startup: https://www.ycombinator.com/jobs

Chapters:
00:00 — 21 Years of YC
01:07 — Why Today’s Startups Are More Ambitious
04:09 — Frighteningly Ambitious Ideas
05:13 — What Actually Motivates Founders
09:28 — What Makes a Founder Formidable
12:54 — What Surprised PG About AI
17:58 — How YC Started and What Hasn’t Changed
title: Paul Graham On Startups, Ambition, and Great Founders
